title: A Concise History of Indian Literature in English

vibeProfile.oneLine: A concise history of Indian literature written in English.

summary: Edited by the poet and critic Arvind Krishna Mehrotra, this history traces the story of Indian literature written in English, from its nineteenth-century beginnings to contemporary fiction and poetry. Combining a clear narrative with critical essays by leading scholars on major authors and movements, it is both accessible and authoritative. A valuable, well-shaped guide to how Indian writing in English grew into one of the most vibrant literatures in the world.
whyReadIt: Mehrotra's authoritative, readable history of Indian writing in English, from its beginnings to now.
